user.title: Set up balenaSound Fleet Monitor
user.description: Monitor balenaSound playback and device status. A balenaCloud API key and fleet/application ID discover fleet devices. Devices on an mDNS-reachable LAN are discovered automatically; optionally add LAN URLs (one UUID=http://address:port per line) as overrides for playback and direct reboot/restart actions.

data.local_device_urls: Device LAN URLs (optional; UUID=http://address:port per line)

error.cannot_connect: Could not authenticate or read this fleet. Check the API key and fleet ID.
